Questions

Which WageGrid metro has the highest Dental hygienists annual median?

Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA has the highest published OEWS May 2025 annual median for Dental Hygienists ($133,740). Among metros with a published median: Seattle $133,740, Austin $105,480, Chicago $100,260. WageGrid does not rank suppressed cells or invent a missing wage.

Which WageGrid metro employs the most Dental hygienists?

Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN has the highest published OEWS May 2025 employment for Dental Hygienists (6,470 wage-and-salary workers). Published employment: Chicago 6,470, Seattle 3,500, Austin 1,270. Self-employed workers are excluded.

Where are Dental hygienists most concentrated relative to the national mix?

Seattle has the highest published location quotient (1.17). Published LQs: Seattle 1.17, Chicago 1.00, Austin 0.69.

What is the hourly median for Dental hygienists in each metro?

OEWS May 2025 hourly medians: Austin $50.71; Chicago $48.20; Seattle $64.30. Blank means BLS withheld the estimate.

Does this comparison include self-employed workers?

No. OEWS covers wage-and-salary workers and excludes the self-employed. WageGrid does not add a self-employment estimate.

U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, May 2025. WageGrid is not affiliated with BLS. Blank cells are BLS suppressions, not estimates.
